present_files: present files in /mnt/user-data/outputs directory for user viewing and rendering in the client interface
normalize_presented_filepath: normalize a file path to the /mnt/user-data/outputs virtual path contract
get_thread_id: resolve the current thread id from runtime context or langgraph config
present_multiple_files: present multiple related files at once for user viewing after creating them
present_files_error_handling: handle errors when presenting files outside /mnt/user-data/outputs directory
